name: Haruno Hinata
source:
Son of Tamami. He is a first-year student at Ijikiri private school. He is a bright, honest, and hardworking person, but his brain and body grow slowly, and he is often mistaken for a girl, which is a source of concern.

He wants to be an American cowboy.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=697660&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
